Note: The primary metric is non-redundant HSF motif-coordinate placements at relative PWM score ≥0.85. Within the 5,000 variable-GC constrained mutants, the original HSF model-position count ranged only from 0 to 1 per sequence; therefore exact-coordinate collapsing cannot change these counts. All 5,119 alternative exact-GC designs contained zero HSF motif-coordinate placements at this threshold. This sensitivity analysis is kept only as an HSF-robustness control and is not used to infer HSF binding or occupancy.
